patch_description: Increase the diversity of deterministic local-search starts while retaining the existing explicit layered construction as the first seed. The current arrangement has useful near-hexagonal structure, but the optimum for 26 circles is boundary-sensitive and generally benefits from unequal radii and broken reflection symmetry. Later starts use smaller, heterogeneous radii and larger controlled coordinate perturbations, allowing SLSQP to discover alternative contact graphs rather than repeatedly refining nearly identical lattice states. A moderate increase in iteration count remains far below the evaluator timeout and the best strictly validated candidate is still selected.
